name: lyrics
description: Time-synced lyrics in a side panel, from LRCLIB and lyrics.ovh.

largeFontSize.label: Font size in the large view

translateTo.label: Translate into
translateTo.description: Shows each line's translation under it, from MyMemory, which gets the lyrics for it. About 5000 characters a day are free, a few songs' worth.

shortcut.label: Shortcut
shortcut.description: Opens and closes the lyrics while the app's window has the focus.

overlay.label: Window over other programs
overlay.description: The line being sung in a small window that stays on top, e.g. over a game. Drag it where you like.

openOnStart.label: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Show the lyrics panel when the app starts.
